Create a test report

Usage: papyrus test-report create [OPTIONS] --description <DESCRIPTION> <TITLE>

Arguments:
  <TITLE>  Test report title

Options:
      --description <DESCRIPTION>      Description of the test report
      --json                           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --applicability <APPLICABILITY>  Optional applicability
      --dir <path>                     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --config <file>                  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --label <LABEL>                  Label
      --no-color                       Disable ANSI color output.
      --reference <REFERENCE>          Reference
  -h, --help                           Print help
